dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: So, mountains like this exist in Teyvat... Living to see victory is such a blessing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A lover of climbing, I see?

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Of course. The mountains are my playground, and the mountaintops are my laurels of victory!

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Victories against who, I hear you ask? Why, my former self, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Victory is when the mountains you climb today are higher than those you climbed the day before.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: My apologies, this is just how we are in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Or should I say, this is how most of us Scions of the Canopy think. If you were talking to the Children of Echoes, they'd probably tell you about heading deep into the mountains, rather than climbing them.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Goodbye, my friend. May all your battles end in victory!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Be careful not to disturb anyone while you're up there.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: I know, I know. I was already warned by a young girl out gathering herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Huh. You look surprised. Did you think I didn't know how this place is home to the adepti of Liyue? Or are you just shocked that I'm making friends with the locals?

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: To be fair, I'm a little surprised by that last one myself.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: That kid was so small she could hardly form a proper sentence, but she climbed all the way up here. Are all people from Liyue born naturally good at extreme sports?
